claim_ceiling: Dense embeddings provide three validated complementary views (citation heritage recovery AUC 0.79-0.85, sachverhalt cross-lingual 0.282, linear hybrid complement PASS adversarial at 19yr+) but do NOT surpass TF-IDF citation hybrids on jurist preference (0.61-0.67 vs 0.78-0.79) at any scale. Full 174k evaluation blocked by corpus lane dependencies.
evidence_summary: 13 evidence references verified across citation heritage (21yr/22yr AUC 0.79-0.85 vs TF-IDF 0.71-0.74), section cross-lingual (1K sample: sachverhalt 0.282, dispositiv 0.150, erwaegungen 0.094), linear combination weight sweeps (15yr FAIL JP=0.473, 19yr PASS w=0.3 JP=0.64-0.65, 22yr PASS w=0.3-0.4 JP=0.61-0.67), center projected evaluations (3yr-22yr all FAIL jurist gate JP 0.05-0.43), legal TF-IDF bge_ corpus (6-8/14 PASS vs 14/14 baseline, AUC ~0.5 citation heritage), and orchestration failure diagnosis (no bge_/bger_ mapping, no 2022-2026 parquet, no section extraction at 174k). Two-mode tradeoff reproduced at all scales: TF-IDF citation hybrids (LangDom~0.48, JP~0.78, CiteIndep~14%) vs Dense (LangDom~0.83-0.98, JP~0.05-0.43, CiteIndep~37%) vs Linear Hybrids (LangDom~0.58-0.80, JP~0.61-0.67). True OOS JuristPref ceiling ~0.53 < 0.7 factory target. Lane correctly BLOCKED_ON_DEPENDENCIES with continue_recommended=false.
